mapper.sql: ROLE_ID AS id, ROLE_CODE AS roleCode, ROLE_NAME AS roleName, ENABLED AS enabled
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ADMIN_ROLE ORDER BY ROLE_ID

SELECT role.ROLE_ID AS id, role.ROLE_CODE AS roleCode, role.ROLE_NAME AS roleName, role.ENABLED AS enabled FROM ADMIN_ROLE role JOIN ADMIN_USER_ROLE user_role ON user_role.ROLE_ID = role.ROLE_ID WHERE user_role.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY role.ROLE_CODE
